title: ORPO: Monolithic Preference Optimization without Reference Model
paper_type_zh: 无参考模型的监督微调与偏好优化一体化研究
best_for_zh: 适合理解如何让偏好对直接改写监督微调目标、而不另设对齐阶段的读者。
one_line: ORPO unifies supervised fine-tuning and pairwise preference optimization through an odds-ratio penalty without a reference model.
ORPO 在监督微调中加入优选/拒选回答的赔率比惩罚，统一完成指令学习和偏好优化而不使用参考模型。
why: It changes the training consumer so that a preference pair modifies SFT directly instead of being reserved for a later alignment stage.
inclusion_reason: Shows how instruction likelihood and a pairwise preference penalty can be consumed by one reference-free training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference alignment is often staged: supervised fine-tuning first learns desirable demonstrations, then a separate method uses preference pairs to adjust the policy. This division duplicates training machinery and often retains a frozen reference model even though the original supervised objective already contains much of the desired behavior.

ORPO asks whether the rejected response can be made useful inside supervised fine-tuning itself. The goal is to consume a favored and disfavored answer together in one objective, so that instruction learning and preference discrimination do not have to be isolated as separate phases.

偏好对齐通常被分成两个阶段：先用监督微调学习理想示范，再用单独的方法借助偏好对调整策略。这种划分会重复训练机制，也常常保留冻结的参考模型，尽管原本的监督目标已包含许多希望模型具备的行为。

ORPO 要回答的是，能否让被拒绝的回答直接在监督微调内部发挥作用。它的目标是用一个统一目标同时消费优选和拒选回答，使指令学习与偏好区分不必被拆成彼此隔离的阶段。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ORPO retains ordinary supervised likelihood for the favored completion, then adds a small penalty based on the odds ratio of the favored and disfavored completions. The policy is therefore encouraged to imitate good answers while becoming less likely to produce the undesired response style.

The pair is not delegated to a later reward-model or direct-preference stage. It is a single training record with two roles: the chosen response supplies the positive instruction target, and the rejected response supplies contrastive evidence about what the same policy should avoid.

ORPO 保留对优选完成的普通监督似然，同时加入基于优选和拒选完成赔率比的小惩罚。因此，策略既被鼓励模仿好的回答，也被推动降低生成不理想回答风格的可能性。

偏好对不会被留给后续奖励模型或直接偏好阶段处理。它是一条承担两种角色的训练记录：优选回答提供正向的指令目标，拒选回答则提供对比证据，说明同一策略应当避免什么。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each prompt, ORPO calculates the chosen response’s language-model likelihood and contrasts the odds of the chosen and rejected responses. A weighting coefficient controls the contribution of the odds-ratio term, allowing the method to remain close to SFT while using the negative answer as a direct training signal.

The reported experiments examine models from 125M to 7B parameters, including Phi-2, Llama 2, and Mistral. The main alignment recipe fine-tunes on UltraFeedback and evaluates instruction following, chat quality, and length-controlled preference performance alongside analyses of the penalty weight.

对于每个提示，ORPO 计算优选回答的语言模型似然，并对比优选和拒选回答的赔率。一个权重系数控制赔率比项的贡献，使方法在保持接近监督微调的同时，把负面回答作为直接训练信号使用。

论文报告的实验覆盖了从 1.25 亿到 70 亿参数的模型，包括 Phi-2、Llama 2 和 Mistral。主要对齐配方在 UltraFeedback 上微调，并评估指令遵循、对话质量和长度控制的偏好表现，同时分析惩罚权重。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that ORPO works across the studied model sizes and that fine-tuning Phi-2, Llama 2, and Mistral on UltraFeedback can outperform larger compared models on several alignment evaluations. The reported Mistral variants are assessed with AlpacaEval 2, IFEval, and MT-Bench, and the authors release code and checkpoints.

This evidence supports the practical feasibility of a one-stage objective, but it does not remove dependence on the quality and coverage of the upstream chosen/rejected pairs. The conclusions also depend on the selected odds-ratio weight and on evaluations centered on chat alignment, rather than all possible downstream capabilities.

论文报告，ORPO 能够跨所研究的模型规模工作；在 UltraFeedback 上微调 Phi-2、Llama 2 和 Mistral 后，可在若干对齐评测上超过被比较的更大模型。报告中的 Mistral 变体使用 AlpacaEval 2、IFEval 和 MT-Bench 评估，作者也发布了代码和检查点。

这些证据支持一阶段目标在实践中可行，但并不能消除对上游优选/拒选对质量与覆盖范围的依赖。结论还取决于所选赔率比权重，也依赖以对话对齐为中心的评测，而非所有可能的下游能力。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior workflows typically treated the preferred answer as SFT material and reserved pairwise comparison for a second objective. ORPO makes the negative answer part of the SFT update through an odds-ratio penalty, so the data lifecycle no longer has a hard boundary between instruction learning and preference alignment.

Its novelty is not just removing a reference model. By making the contrastive term deliberately small and attaching it to the likelihood objective, ORPO proposes a different answer to which training consumer should own a preference pair: the supervised fine-tuning step itself.

较早的流程通常把优选回答当作监督微调材料，把成对比较留给第二个目标。ORPO 通过赔率比惩罚让负面回答参与监督微调更新，因此数据生命周期不再在指令学习与偏好对齐之间设置明确边界。

它的新意不只是去掉参考模型。通过有意把对比项设得较小并附着在似然目标上，ORPO 对“哪一个训练使用方应当拥有偏好对”给出了不同答案：就是监督微调步骤本身。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The odds-ratio coefficient mediates a real trade-off and must be tuned for a model and dataset; an overly strong penalty can damage language modeling or useful verbosity, while a weak one may add little beyond SFT. ORPO also inherits annotation errors, response-length artifacts, and coverage gaps from its pairwise source, and its reference-free design does not by itself guarantee stable behavior after distribution shift.
赔率比系数调节着真实的权衡，必须针对模型和数据集进行调参；过强的惩罚可能损害语言建模或有用的详尽程度，过弱则可能几乎不比监督微调多带来收益。ORPO 还会继承成对来源中的标注错误、回答长度伪影和覆盖缺口；其无参考模型设计本身并不保证分布变化后的行为稳定。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use ORPO when instruction demonstrations and preferred/dispreferred alternatives are available together and the training system should remain a single SFT-like pass. It is useful for deciding whether rejected answers should be discarded, saved for a later alignment stage, or attached directly to the supervised objective as contrastive evidence.
当指令示范与优选/拒选替代答案可以同时获得，并且训练系统希望保持为一次类似监督微调的过程时，可使用 ORPO。它有助于决定拒选回答应被丢弃、留给后续对齐阶段，还是作为对比证据直接附加到监督目标中。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the analysis of the odds-ratio weight with the result tables rather than treating the objective as a parameter-free replacement for SFT. For reproduction, verify the preference-pair formatting, chat template, UltraFeedback revision, length handling, and the exact checkpoints used for comparisons; each changes what the negative response teaches the policy.
应将赔率比权重分析与结果表一同阅读，而不要把该目标当成无需参数的监督微调替代品。复现时需核验偏好对格式、对话模板、UltraFeedback 版本、长度处理以及比较所用检查点；每一项都会改变负面回答向策略传递的内容。
